thread:
Sam (Support): Flagging urgent onboarding failure for MediCore. They've been hitting 502s from our embed endpoint since last night and self-service provisioning didn't enable additional dedicated capacity. Go-live is next Tue; AE says they might pull budget if unresolved. Logs: ```error: model shim: OOM at kv_cache_init; retry x3``` @Priya can you take point on CS comms? :warning:

Priya (CSM): On it, Sam. Thanks for the heads up. I'll coordinate customer outreach. Need confirmation on ETA for fix and a temporary mitigation we can offer.

Omar (Solutions Eng): Looking at logs now. Short story: KV cache growth on long-context streams + quantized variant mismatch. Two options: 1) Temp route to smaller-context model (rwd-compat-7B) + token-cost note. 2) Patch runtime to limit prefix KV allocation (low-risk config) — could prod deploy in ~3h. Which do we prefer for customer-facing comms?

Jesse (Onboarding PM): From onboarding schedule: MediCore's data ingest and long-prompt tests run nightly; might be causing unusually long prefixes. If we route to smaller model, some bits of accuracy drop. Will the AE accept that trade?

Liam (AE): Confirmed they will accept short-term downgrade if we clearly communicate impact and timeline. Priority is sticking the demo next Tue. I can tell them we'll escalate and have a call today. Please include me on comms.

Priya (CSM): Proposed comms plan: 1) Immediate note to customer acknowledging issue + ETA (1h triage, 3h mitigation). 2) Offer scheduled call for 2pm PST today. 3) Temporary routing to rwd-compat-7B + config change as rollback plan. 4) Post-mortem and compensation if SLA breached. Ok?

Sam (Support): I'll patch the support ticket with the comms copy. Draft: "We're seeing an ingestion edge-case causing memory pressure for long-context workflows. We're putting a temporary routing in place to ensure your demo behaves predictably. We'll follow up with a remediation timeline and post-mortem." Thoughts?

Omar (Solutions Eng): Approve. I'll start the runtime config change now (limit prefix allocation) and test on staging. If green, I'll push to prod via canary. ETA 2.5h.

Priya (CSM): Great. @Liam can you schedule the 2pm PST call and add Jesse + Omar + Sam? Also will prepare an FAQ paragraph on capabilities differences for the fallback model.

Liam (AE): Scheduled. Meeting invite sent to MediCore + internal quick sync. Adding the template comms to the ticket now.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-4873 — "medicore-embed-kv-cache-pressure". Severity: P2. Assigned: Omar.

Jesse (Onboarding PM): I'll pause nightly ingest for MediCore until we confirm the runtime patch, to reduce load and give space for testing. Notifying their integration lead.

Priya (CSM): Thanks team. Action items summary:
- Omar: runtime config change + canary (ETA 2.5h)
- Sam: update ticket comms and customer-facing note (now)
- Liam: customer call 2pm PST (done)
- Jesse: pause nightly ingest (now)
We'll reconvene in #incident-bridge thread after canary. :thumbsup: 

Sam (Support): Added comms to ticket and pinged customer. Will post play-by-play here as things change.
